# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Stage Positional Repeatability Error Mapping & Psi/Delta Film Uniformity Extraction

**Discipline / Category**: Metrology  
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Digital Multimeter / Optical Quad Encoder.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Coupling stage positioning repeatability directly to multi-point optical ellipsometry introduces serious Abbe error and angular pitch/yaw propagation. A C7 rolled ball screw and standard MGN12H guide rail setup exhibits angular pitch/yaw deviations up to 50-80 arcsec; over an optical beam throw of 100 mm, an 80 arcsec tilt produces an optical incident angle error delta_theta of approximately 0.022 degrees, distorting ellipsometric Psi and Delta film fits and creating pseudo-thickness variations across the 49-point wafer grid.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Ellipsometric Psi/Delta extraction for 180nm dielectric thin films (e.g. 3.5 nm gate oxide or 100 nm Si3N4) is extremely sensitive to ambient surface hydrocarbon adsorption and moisture condensation during extended multi-point mapping runs. Furthermore, improper optical modeling neglecting interface roughness or utilizing uncalibrated Cauchy parameters instead of a rigorous point-by-point Sellmeier/EMA model will corrupt the extracted film uniformity across stage coordinates.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying C7 rolled ball screws and commodity MGN12H linear guides presents high component-to-component runout variance. Upgrading to ground C5 ball screws or integrating 1.0 um resolution magnetic/optical linear scales locally sourced in Vietnam/ASEAN is essential to maintain positional repeatability without encountering long import lead times or prohibitive customs delays for precision motion components.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The calibration schedule must enforce strict stage thermal soak stabilization (minimum 60 minutes) prior to mapping. Attempting to execute 49-point wafer mapping concurrently with open stepper driver loops risks thermal drift in NEMA 17 motor mounts, skewing repeatability verification and delaying sign-off for Gen 1 lithography stage deployment.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Abbe offset and stage pitch/yaw angular runout inducing angle-of-incidence (AOI) deviations exceeding ±0.05°, causing false radial thickness gradients in extracted Psi/Delta spectra.
1. Motor thermal expansion causing cumulative linear position drift (>5 µm) during prolonged multi-point automated mapping cycles.
1. Airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and native oxide growth during prolonged stage dwell times exceeding cleanroom queue limits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN1-MM-3-3-3-01` | **Bi-Directional Multi-Point Stage Positional Repeatability and Backlash Mapping** | Renishaw XL-80 laser interferometer or dual-axis linear optical scale (0.1 µm resolution), calibrated invar artifact fixture, thermal environmental chamber (20 ± 0.1 °C). | 1. Define a 7x7 grid (49 points) over a 150 mm x 150 mm travel envelope corresponding to 150 mm wafer coordinates. 2. Execute 10 bi-directional approach cycles (forward and reverse) for each programmed coordinate. 3. Record linear positional deviation (delta_x, delta_y) and angular deviation (pitch, yaw) at every dwell point. 4. Compute mean positional error, standard deviation (sigma), bi-directional repeatability (ISO 230-2), and mechanical backlash. | `Bi-directional positional repeatability R <= 3.0 µm (3-sigma) across all 49 points; mechanical backlash <= 2.0 µm; pitch and yaw angular runout <= 30 arcsec.` |
| `TC-GEN1-MM-3-3-3-02` | **49-Point Psi/Delta Film Uniformity and Optical Angle of Incidence Stability Extraction** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (wavelength range 250-850 nm, focused micro-spot beam <= 200 µm), thermal oxide calibration wafer (nominal 100.0 nm SiO2 on Si <100>). | 1. Program automated stage trajectory to translate wafer through standard 49-point polar/cartesian map. 2. At each position, capture raw polarization parameters Psi(lambda) and Delta(lambda) at nominal AOI = 70.00°. 3. Extract fitted SiO2 film thickness and refractive index n(632.8 nm) using a validated Cauchy dispersion model. 4. Re-measure center point (0,0) after completing the 49-point loop to evaluate instrument and stage drift. | `Extracted film thickness measurement precision 1-sigma <= 0.08 nm across 5 repeated center dwells; stage-induced AOI error <= ±0.03°; calculated radial non-uniformity (max - min) / (2 * mean) <= 1.2% for the standard wafer.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100/ISO 5 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser safety glasses (optical density OD 5+ at ellipsometer source wavelength), ESD-safe cleanroom frock, hood, and conductive shoe covers, Polycarbonate face shield during solvent wipe maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush immediately with clean eyewash water for minimum 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air immediately; provide artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing is labored. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with non-abrasive soap and copious water; remove contaminated garments immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within laminar flow hood or Class 100 cleanroom bay with min 45 air changes/hr; dedicated solvent vapor extraction exhaust (face velocity >= 0.5 m/s or 100 fpm) installed over wafer cleaning and stage solvent wipe zones.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA and acetone in dedicated, grounded, stainless-steel flammable solvent waste carboys labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste'; do not drain dispose or mix with oxidizers; purge purge-lines with UHP N2.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade (SEMI C4) | `> 99.8%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C1) | `> 99.5%` |
| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP, Grade 5.0) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched/rinsed Si wafer with pristine native oxide stripped (HF-last) or post-furnace thermal oxide (hydrophobic or clean hydrophilic surface, contact angle <= 10°, zero particulate contamination > 0.3 µm).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized thin film surface with complete optical map, zero carbonaceous laser beam marks, and ambient hydrocarbon adsorption thickness < 0.2 nm.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure queue time leads to adventitious organic hydrocarbon deposition and uncontrolled native oxide growth (+0.3 nm to +0.5 nm), degrading ellipsometric model fit quality (GOF < 0.98) and producing inaccurate baseline stage repeatability calibrations.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed 49-point stage repeatability calibration matrix and correlated spectroscopic ellipsometry Psi/Delta film thickness uniformity maps across a 150 mm travel envelope, demonstrating sub-3 µm mechanical positioning repeatability and sub-Angstrom optical film thickness extraction precision under Gen 1 macroscopic lithography cleanroom conditions.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `stage_repeatability_error_map_49pt.csv`
- [ ] `psi_delta_dielectric_uniformity_report.pdf`
- [ ] `wafer_thickness_contour_topography.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Stage bi-directional linear positional repeatability over 49 points** | `2.5 µm` | <= 3.0 µm (3-sigma) | ISO 230-2 statistical evaluation using dual-axis laser interferometer positional data |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Ellipsometric dielectric film thickness measurement precision at repeated center dwell** | `0.05 nm` | <= 0.08 nm (1-sigma) | Repeated 10-cycle acquisition of Psi/Delta spectra at (0,0) coordinate fitted via Cauchy dispersion model |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Angular Abbe pitch and yaw stage wobble across total travel** | `20.0 arcsec` | <= 30.0 arcsec | Electronic dual-axis autocollimator angular pitch/yaw mapping during continuous stage traversal |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal approval granted when all 49 grid points demonstrate bi-directional repeatability <= 3.0 µm, ellipsometric model goodness-of-fit (GOF) >= 0.990 on reference oxide wafers, thermal drift over the entire automated mapping routine <= 1.0 µm, and cleanroom air queue limits are strictly maintained without contamination.
